{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "esnext",
    "lib": [
      "dom",
      "dom.iterable",
      "esnext"
    ],
    "types": [
      "node",
      "next",
      "jest"
    ],
    "allowJs": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "strict": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "noEmit": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "module": "esnext",
    "moduleResolution": "node",
    "resolveJsonModule": true,
    "isolatedModules": true,
    "jsx": "react-jsx",
    "incremental": true,
    "experimentalDecorators": true
  },
  "include": [
    "next-env.d.ts",
    "**/*.ts",
    "**/*.tsx",
    "types.d.ts",
    "./jest.setup.js"
  ],
  "exclude": [
    "node_modules"
  ]
}

/**
 * Gets the Google domain for a given country code
 * @param countryCode - The ISO 2-letter country code
 * @returns The Google domain for the country, or 'google.com' as fallback
 */
export const getGoogleDomain = (countryCode: string): string => {
   const country = countries[countryCode.toUpperCase()];
   return country?.[4] ?? 'google.com';
};
